content: Itzama s'anọngẹya m'ọyagbin
Iwa anọngẹya attẹwọr ahaabh m'ọyagbin, bẹ abira amaan va p'ipanọng anang bẹ,
va p'Ibinọkpaabyi are bi, va mba p'ipanọng p'anọngẹya ajibh-ojibh. Mẹ wọ osi, bẹ an-atzekha ayok bani, atzọkha bẹ macha panọng pabẹ.

Mẹ wọ osi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, “Egwugwuma chaam ch'esi anọng aruk akpen, ttara ọnọngẹya dọk kewobha matzẹmaa ikhina ogbe ode, okhuri bi, ọnọngẹya ode ọkpakpa. Ttẹwọr madeden, anọngẹya akpen dọk káruk ayongi cho arọbh azadani.”
K'ogbe nwuma, ttara kw'oyongi mẹ, wa aNẹphilim
awobh m'ọyagbin, mada va p'Ibinọkpaabyi ayim aminava p'anọngẹya abẹ, aminava mba atzima ọbhọr, amaan bẹ va. Va mba bọ iwa ade afa-nọng, bẹ abira ade ajinọng p'atza che.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ore bi, itzama s'anọngẹya ikk'ibara kpọng-kpọng m'ọyagbin, ttara bi, achibhi p'anọngẹya biphyir an-ade epyibha, k'ogbe kpenamkpen.
Wa Ibinọkpaabyi for sẹ isẹ-ẹ nkwo, ettem ebire ẹmmẹ-ẹ, k'anọngẹya p'ọkk'ọsa m'ọyagbin.

Mẹ wọ osi, on-oben for sẹ bi, “Kaam ńdimi anọngẹya biphyir pa nkk'nsa, manda wani m'ọyagbin kórik. Kaam mbiri ńdimi nden biphyir, ọmaana ọnọhn f'ẹrọng biphyir, ọmaana ekpo py'ereng k'irerek biphyir. For saam isi-m nkwo bi, kaam nkk'pyẹ nyokha.”
Yina, iwa Noa ọtzọk ọphyaam k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
Odem kw'okhuri Noa
Ma wọ ode odem kw'okhuri Noa. Wa Noa ode ọnọng kw'otzor-otzor, oponga-pyibha kobiro ọkhaama mach'anọng p'ogbe kwẹ. Kẹ wa ọtzọni Ibinọkpaabyi abẹ.
Wa Noa obhoni ajinọng attaan p'ade Shẹm, ọmaana Ham ttara Japhẹt.
Wa Ibinọkpaabyi on-ore bi, ọyagbin okk'okhibhi, obiro ore bi, ọyagbin on-ofu ttara ọgbaan.
Ibinọkpaabyi ore odem kw'ọyagbin okk'okhibhi opyiri, da anọngẹya biphyir k'ọyagbin akk'akpen pa bẹ akhibhi.
Mẹ wọ osi, Ibinọkpaabyi oben Noa bi, “Kaam nkk'ochibhi nsa bi, ńdimi anọngẹya biphyir, da ọyagbin on-ofu ttara ọgbaan, okhuri ọnọngẹya. Kker e, kaam ńdimi anọngẹya odimi biphyir ttara ọyagbin nwa.

Kọ Noa, tzima agbaakhakpa p'echi ch'ẹgaang-ọgaangi, amun ọkpaar kw'ideden anang for sọ. Si mmanggọ k'ọkpaar nwa ẹtzaanga, atzima ẹbaanttim akpa aphaangi pẹ k'iyaan, ọmaana k'ẹtzaanga, ifha asi aningi k'ọkpaar ẹtzaanga adimi.
Manda wọ kw'arenga amun ọkpaar nwa. Adum pẹ áde ndọkhi ẹnọhna obhiri arọbh afa obhiri jobh, ẹ̀kpá chẹ éde ndọkhi arọbh attaan obhiri chi, ebe chẹ éde ndọkhi arọbh afa obhiri nzen.

Si ittakhọhnga abubh-ẹ, ttẹwọr k'amma-kpabem pyiri k'ittakhọhnga, ahok ọphaangi kw'óde ẹtzọkhi k'obungi ọmaana igbokha makhọra. Si ọmma k'ẹbhabhaanga ch'okhubha wani kw'ọkpaar nwa, asi nyọng nttaan, dani k'irekh-irek, dani m'ottem, ndongo k'ẹrọng.
Kaam ńdọhm asi p'áchi ọttọhk kpenamkpen m'ọyagbin, ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'orukhi akpen. Ọttọhk kpenamkpen m'ọyagbin óbiro ópope.
Onode kọ, kaam ńsi echekhi chaam nnang kọ ọmaana va pọ, ttara kwanọng kwọ, ọmaana panọng pa va pọ, bọng biphyir adim k'ọkpaar nwa ẹtzaanga.
Kọ átzọkha adem afa-afa p'ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'orukhi akpen, ojinọng ọmaana kwanọng, adim k'ọkpaar nwa ẹtzaanga, ifha pyẹ eruk akpen ttara kọ k'ọkpaar.
Adem afa-afa p'ọnọhn kpenamkpen, ọmaana pa nden kpenamkpen, ttara p'ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'oreng k'irerek, ékwu ifha ahok pyẹ akpen.
Kọ tzobha ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'ode ọchattọhk ọnang bọng, f'obiro ode ọchattọhk ọnang nden nnonggo biphyir, aye k'ọkpaar.”
Noa osi odik kpenamkpen mach'Ibinọkpaabyi ọtzọhn-ẹ.

footnotes.text: 6.4 K'eHiburu, ọwọhng nwa kwa Nephilim oyini atzọhmi p'areng k'osisi kwabẹ atto k'Ibinọkpaabyi itzitzikha. Wa Nephilim ade atzọhmi pa panọng p'ọyagbin amaani, yina, abatte p'egwugwuma abhon bẹ.
